title: Ground Truth Schema
description: DynamoDB table schema for ground truth labels and annotations

Id.description: Primary key - Unique identifier for the ground truth record (UUID)

Name.description: Name or title of the ground truth annotation set
Name.example: Product Demo - Action Detection Ground Truth

Description.description: Description of the ground truth task, including MME search keywords, labeling instructions, or task context (e.g., 'all the pets', 'all the vehicles', 'sport score events')
Description.example: MME search keyword: 'person playing basketball'. Label all segments showing basketball gameplay and scoring events.

CreatedBy.description: User who created the ground truth (from Cognito)

CreatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the ground truth was created

VideoId.description: Foreign key reference to the video table

VideoAnalyzeTaskIds.description: List of foreign key references to video analyze tasks

Status.description: Current status of the ground truth record

Labels.description: Array of labeled segments with timestamps and scores

Score.description: Score value (MME search distance, confidence score, or similarity metric)

Label.description: Optional label or category for the segment

ReviewResult.description: Review result classification for the label

video_id-index.description: GSI for querying ground truth by video ID

video_analyze_task_ids-index.description: GSI for querying ground truth by video analyze task IDs

examples.Name: Product Demo - Action Detection Ground Truth
examples.Description: MME search keyword: 'product demonstration'. Label all segments showing product features and demonstrations.

examples.Name: Training Video - Scene Segmentation
examples.Description: Manual labeling instruction: Identify all scene transitions and label introduction segments. Focus on clear visual breaks between scenes.

dynamodb_specifics: VideoId-index GSI enables efficient queries for all ground truth records for a video
VideoAnalyzeTaskIds-index GSI enables queries for ground truth related to specific analysis tasks
All field names use PascalCase convention for consistency
usage: Ground truth records are used for evaluation and validation of model predictions
Labels array contains manually annotated segments with timestamps
Score can represent confidence, similarity, or distance metrics depending on use case
Label field is optional to support both labeled and unlabeled annotations
